Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Okay, Isabella. Say "Aaaah".

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (opens mouth) Ahhhh...

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Oh, good. The swelling has gone down dramatically. I'll be back to check on you soon. (exits)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Isabella, what'cha dooooin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Raspy voice) Oh, just recovering. But I finally got my tonsillectomy patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just came by to cheer you up. And to see if you're feeling well enough to go on with our event.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry, guys. My throat still hurts like crazy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's cool. Sorry, gang. We've got to postpone the Trojan War reenactment till further notice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, the best part of getting your tonsils out is that you get to eat all the ice cream you want.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mountains of it! You could have the biggest ice cream sundae ever made! (to Ferb) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! First, we gotta draw up some plans. Wait, no time for that. You go to Blueprint Heaven; I'll head home to meet the delivery guy. (Phone beeps) Hello? Blowtorch City? Yeah, I'll hold. (to Isabella) When are they letting you out of this joint?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This afternoon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perfect, we should have just enough time.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: So, I'm going out, Vanessa. Remember, you're at your Dad's this weekend.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Great. A whole 48 hours of evil.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Vanessa Doofenshmirtz, your father is not evil. We just didn't get along. We wanted different things.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Was one of those things "To be evil"? Because he's evil.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: He's not evil, honey. No one's evil.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, Mom. He's evil. You don't notice about him? He has evil schemes. Normal people don't have schemes of any kind. And then there's this secret agent that always bursts in, and--

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I think you're being overly dramatic.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Mom, I'm not being dramatic. Dad builds evil contraptions every day. Wait. (Phone beeps) Let me check on something.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Phone beeps) Yup. He's even got his own evil jingle right on his answering machine. (Speed dial) Listen!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On Phone) Hello?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, hello, Heinz.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad! Why did you pick up? You always let the machine get it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I heard it ring the first time, so I was standing right by the phone. Oh, by the way, could you pick up some blueprints for me on your way over? Thank you, sweetie.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Great. Now he wants me to pick up some evil blueprints for his latest evil contraption. And as soon as he's done building it, I'll have proof! I'll call you, and you can see for yourself.

Name: Worker
Dialog: So, you need plans to build a giant ice cream sundae maker, do you? Hmm, I'm not sure we sell blueprints for that anymore. Whoa! Hold on, sweetie. No need to get upset. I'll go check in the back, okay? Okay. Let's see. Giant sundae machine. I got a yogurt machine! How that sound? Yeah, I don't care for yogurt either, baby. I'll keep looking. You're in luck. I found one! Now, what do you need, sweetie?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm here to pick up an order for Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Worker
Dialog: Oh, yes. Your Daddy just called.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Looks at Ferb) Hey, how's it goin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Can you bring it back here? Thanks. That's great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her phone) You're not gonna believe this, Stacy, but when I turned around, Jeremy was standing right behind me. Well, actually he was sitting, and he was a couple blocks away, but he was right there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (from outside) Keep it coming, keep it coming! Okay, stop. Great. Stack 'em over here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, Stace? I'm gonna have to call you back.

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: And that's the last of it. Eh, just need you to sign right here, and...Say, aren't you a little...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Young to be using titanium plating and an industrial arc welder? Yes. Yes I am. I get that a lot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you know I'm in charge, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, isn't that just if a satellite crashes into the-

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! When Mom's at her cooking class, I'm in charge. Now, what are you up to out here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'd like to tell you, but it's gonna be a big surprise. Hey, wait a second. Have you seen Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to wake you, Agent P. Looks like Doofenshmirtz is getting sloppy. He sent his daughter right into our sting operation and purchased blueprints for a Space Las-inator. We intended to pass him fake plans, but due to a rookie error, and by "rookie", I mean Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, my bad.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The plans he received are real; terrifyingly real.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Again, I must apologize, I was in character--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You better step on it, Agent P. Before it's too late.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Can you give me a hand unpacking this stuff, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not gonna help you. But as soon as I figure out what you're up to, I'm calling Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Say hi for me!

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: Bonjour, class. Today we will be making crepes Guilbaud.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, is everything all right? Well, if you don't even know what he's doing, how do you know if it's a problem?

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: (Clears throat) Is there something you would like to share with the whole class?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sorry, sir. (At Phone) Candace, I'll talk to you later, okay? (Phone beeps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls) I'm keeping an eye on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. You got the blueprints? Excellent! Isabella's gonna love it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you—you're early. I haven't even started yet. My-my daughter should be here any minute with the blueprints, though. Oh, there she is. (At Vanessa) Good morning, Vanessa. You remember Perry the Platypus.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, hi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, why don't you have a seat in my waiting area? Read some magazines! Sorry they're all in Spanish, I--I steal them from my neighbor. You know, evil never rests.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So, Dad, this plan, it's evil, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, yes it is! It's nice to see you taking an interest in the family business.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's all I need to know. (Phone beeps)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I'm in class now, Vanessa. I have to go. Mmm-hmm. Mmm-hmm. Yes, Vanessa, I'll leave my phone on. (To Linda) Teenagers. Ugh. What are we making this week?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I think it's crepes, but you know, I can't understand his accent.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, it's finally ready! (Button beeps) Too bad you can do nothing but watch as I prepare to launch my Space Laser-Inator!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, I bet that thing must be really evil, huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, take a look out that window and tell me what you see.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, not much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly! Ever since that stupid billboard went up, my panoramic view is completely ruined. I used to have this perfect vantage point for enjoying the delicious misery of others.

Name: Man
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Woman
Dialog: You owe $78,000.

Name: Man #3
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, after I launch this baby into orbit, my problem will be solved! Then, I can go on to eliminate all the other annoyances that make my skin crawl! Like, uh...nature! (Laser zaps) Beauty! (Laser zaps)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Morning talk show hosts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon, there will be nothing that can withstand the wrath of Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Doctor? Since when are you a doctor?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They don't just give these out to anybody, you know.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Anybody with 15 bucks, they do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's enough looking! I'd love to debate you, but I have some pressing business to take care of, like remaking the Tri-State Area in my own, twisted image! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh my gosh! This is worse than I thought! Oh, Dad is going to be so busted.

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: Now, carefully pour the batter. Slowly, slowly. (Phone rings, Glass smashes)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake! Vanessa?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, this better be important.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: He's doing what?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, are you sure you're not exaggerating just a little bit?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well, it's not that I don't believe you, honey...

Name: Linda
Dialog: But every time I race home, I find out everything is just fine.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Yes, I'll be right over. (Phone beeps)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm on my way. (Phone beeps) Teenagers!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Tell me about it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, to launch my creation and begin my reign of terror! Evil terror. (Button beeps, whirring; Ding) Huh? Ah. (ice cream splats onto him) Ugh... Well, this can't be right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Get ready for a giant sundae!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this can't be right. Lemme see those blueprints. Oh, wait a minute. Those are the plans for a Space Laser-inator, apparently. I was wondering what that thing was for. That must be the laser. (briefly, we see the laser on the ground) It's a good thing we didn't attach it, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom! Hurry!! Come on, come on!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids. How are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just about to make a nice handmade sundae for Isabella.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that is so sweet! Come on in the kitchen. I'll help you with it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Come on, Mom! Hurry!

Name: Vanessa (cont.)
Dialog: (with her eyes closed) See?! Evil!! I told you!!!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Hmm...um, that's not evil, dear.

Name: Charlene (cont.)
Dialog: A bit much, perhaps. Heinz, what is all this? I thought you were lactose intolerant.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am!!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (presses button; more ice cream falls) Oh... I'm paying you way too much alimony. (Notices Perry, now in pet mode) And what's over there? That is no way to treat your pet!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But Mom, that's a secret agent!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: A secret agent? He's just a little platypus. They don't do much, you know.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, guys, this is amazing! I was afraid you guys were gonna go overboard and build some giant sundae contraption or something!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, we were gonna do that, but we accidentally built a space laser instead. (At Ferb) Ferb, you're usually so focused. How'd you get those plans confused?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, how's it goin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Snap out of it. What happened back there?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (pause) I was weak.
